title: Resolving NPS Issues: A Guide to PFRDA Pension Sahayak
description: The PFRDA Pension Sahayak portal offers a streamlined online platform for National Pension System (NPS) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY) subscribers to raise and.

faq.q: What is the PFRDA Pension Sahayak portal?
faq.a: It is an online grievance redressal platform launched by the PFRDA for subscribers of the National Pension System (NPS) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY) to register and track their complaints and queries.

faq.q: How do I access the Pension Sahayak portal?
faq.a: You can access the portal through the official website of the PFRDA (pfrda.org.in) by looking for the 'Grievance' or 'Pension Sahayak' section.

faq.q: What kind of complaints can I file on Pension Sahayak?
faq.a: You can file complaints related to various NPS and APY issues, including uncredited contributions, incorrect personal details, delays in withdrawals, or issues with scheme changes.

faq.q: What information is needed to file a complaint?
faq.a: You will typically need your PRAN, registered contact details, a clear description of your grievance, and any supporting documents like bank statements or transaction receipts.

faq.q: How can I track the status of my complaint?
faq.a: After filing, you will receive a unique Grievance ID. You can use this ID on the Pension Sahayak portal to check the real-time status and progress of your complaint.

faq.q: What happens if my complaint is not resolved promptly?
faq.a: The portal has an in-built escalation mechanism. If your complaint is not resolved by the initial entity within a stipulated timeframe, it is automatically escalated to the PFRDA Grievance Redressal Cell, and further to the NPS Ombudsman if needed.

faq.q: Is there a fee to use the Pension Sahayak portal?
faq.a: No, the PFRDA Pension Sahayak portal is a free service provided by the PFRDA to facilitate grievance redressal for NPS and APY subscribers.
